none: PAS KENT-9EF452: Roman. Coin. Nummus or AE4 of Valentinian I. Obverse view.
contea di ritrovamento: Kent (Inghilterra e Galles)

A complete, Roman, struck or hammered, copper alloy, nummus or AE4 of Valentinian I (364-375AD). Obverse: Pearl diadem bust right. Inscription: DN VALENTINI[]. Reverse: Emperor advancing right, dragging a barbarian and holding a labrum. Inscription: GLORIA [ROMA]NORVM. Mint name: Lyons (France) Mint mark: OF crescent & dot II//LVGP. Reece period 19. Die axis: 6 o'clock. This coin is in fine condition with some wear and slightly corroded, irregular edges. It has an attractive olive green patina but some light rusty brown staining on both sides. This coin is likely to date to 367-375AD. Ref. Coins of England and the UK, Spink 2011, page 64 no. 619A, Identifying Roman Coins, Richard Reece &…
